title: Mimir Wave 18 — P1: mimirClient.ts + config.ts env vars + .env.example
spec:
Implement Phase 1 of the Cisco Mimir API integration (Wave 18) into the Helix platform. This is backend-only — no UI changes in this phase.

## Files to Create / Modify

### 1. NEW: `platforms/serviceflow-sdm/backend/src/integrations/mimirClient.ts`

Create a `MimirClient` class following the exact same pattern as `smartLicensingClient.ts` (OAuth2 client_credentials token caching) and `tacClient.ts` (graceful empty returns on error).

Requirements:
- Private `tokenCache: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null`
- Constructor takes `(baseUrl: string, tokenUrl: string, clientId: string, clientSecret: string)`
- `private async getAccessToken(): Promise<string>` — POST to tokenUrl with `grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id`, `client_secret` as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. Cache token in memory; refresh 60s before expiry. Returns empty string (no throw) if clientId/clientSecret are empty — this allows the app to start without credentials configured.
- All HTTP requests use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Timeout: 15000ms on all fetch calls.
- Response envelope: `{ meta: { pagination, attributes, status }, data: [] }` — always return `data` array or typed object.

Typed interfaces to define (export all):
```typescript
export interface MimirDevice { deviceName: string; ipAddress: string; productId: string; swVersion: string; role: string; }
export interface MimirPsirtSummary { totalCount: number; critical: number; high: number; medium: number; low: number; }
export interface MimirFnSummary { totalCount: number; affectedDevices: number; }
export interface MimirQbrComposite { riskComposite: number; psirtScore: number; fnScore: number; hwLifecycleScore: number; swLifecycleScore: number; }
export interface MimirBenchmark { psirtCountPeerComparison: unknown; fnCountPeerComparison: unknown; }
export interface MimirBpSummary { complianceScore: number; passCount: number; failCount: number; }
```

Methods to implement (all take `companyId: string`, return graceful empty on error — log warn, never throw):
- `async getNpDevices(companyId: string): Promise<MimirDevice[]>` → GET `{baseUrl}/np/devices?companyId={companyId}`
- `async getPsirtSummary(companyId: string): Promise<MimirPsirtSummary | null>` → GET `{baseUrl}/np/psirt-summary?companyId={companyId}`
- `async getFnSummary(companyId: string): Promise<MimirFnSummary | null>` → GET `{baseUrl}/np/fn-summary?companyId={companyId}`
- `async getQbrComposite(companyId: string): Promise<MimirQbrComposite | null>` → GET `{baseUrl}/qbr/risk-composite?companyId={companyId}`
- `async getBcibmPeerComparison(companyId: string): Promise<MimirBenchmark | null>` → GET `{baseUrl}/bcibm/psirt-count-peer-comparison?companyId={companyId}`
- `async getBpSummary(companyId: string): Promise<MimirBpSummary | null>` → GET `{baseUrl}/compliance/bp-summary?companyId={companyId}`

Export a factory function at bottom of file:
```typescript
export function createMimirClient(env: { MIMIR_BASE_URL: string; MIMIR_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL: string; MIMIR_CLIENT_ID: string; MIMIR_CLIENT_SECRET: string }): MimirClient {
  return new MimirClient(env.MIMIR_BASE_URL, env.MIMIR_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL, env.MIMIR_CLIENT_ID, env.MIMIR_CLIENT_SECRET);
}
```

### 2. MODIFY: `platforms/serviceflow-sdm/backend/src/config.ts`

In the `EnvSchema` z.object({...}), add these 4 entries after the SALESFORCE block (before the closing `}`):

```typescript
/** Cisco Mimir API — Wave 18 (OAuth2 client_credentials, M2M). */
MIMIR_BASE_URL: z.string().default("https://mimir-prod.cisco.com/api/mimir"),
MIMIR_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL: z.string().default("https://cloudsso.cisco.com/as/token.oauth2"),
MIMIR_CLIENT_ID: z.string().optional().default(""),
MIMIR_CLIENT_SECRET: z.string().optional().default(""),
```

### 3. MODIFY: `platforms/serviceflow-sdm/.env.example`

Add a new section at the end of the file:

```
# ─── Cisco Mimir API — Wave 18 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# OAuth2 client_credentials M2M. Obtain client_id/secret from Cisco CX/IT.
MIMIR_BASE_URL=https://mimir-prod.cisco.com/api/mimir
MIMIR_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=https://cloudsso.cisco.com/as/token.oauth2
MIMIR_CLIENT_ID=
MIMIR_CLIENT_SECRET=
```

## Standards
- No credentials hardcoded — env vars only (codeguard-1-hardcoded-credentials)
- Use EVP/secure patterns for any crypto; OAuth token transport over HTTPS only
- All fetch calls: `timeout: 15000`, handle network errors gracefully (log warn, return null/empty)
- Follow existing client file style exactly — check tacClient.ts and smartLicensingClient.ts for patterns
- TypeScript strict mode — no `any` except where mapping unknown Mimir response shapes
- Export all interfaces at top of file before the class

## Definition of Done
- `mimirClient.ts` compiles with `tsc --noEmit` from `backend/` with no errors
- `config.ts` still passes its existing Zod validation (all new fields have defaults)
- `.env.example` updated with all 4 MIMIR_ vars
- If `.env.example` does not exist yet in that directory, create it and include all existing env vars you can find referenced in config.ts plus the new MIMIR_ vars
